season.note: Best/worst by median 1-year return from that calendar month, 2011–2025.

scaleWindows.method: Buy every day in the window. Average 1-year return after each buy. Window must work in 2012, 2016, and 2020 (score = worst of those three).

bestLate.label: Days 893–982 after a halving
bestLate.note: Late-cycle scale box. Sits next to the usual bottom search window.

bestEarly.label: Days 99–188 after a halving
bestEarly.note: Early-cycle scale box. Strong in every sample; 2012/2016 numbers are huge because price was still tiny.

worst.label: Days 510–599 after a halving
worst.note: Overlaps the usual top search box. Daily adds here were underwater a year later in every cycle.
